description: ACCDB full 4-route enforcement of field rule W.ValidationRule = "<> 'a' And <> 'b'" (AllowZeroLength=True). Tests INSERT and UPDATE of pass ('z'), fail clause 1 ('a'), fail clause 2 ('b'), Null, and '' through DAO Execute (128), DAO Execute (0), DAO dynaset AddNew/Edit+Update, and ADO Connection.Execute (ACE.OLEDB.12.0), first without ValidationText (3317 default text) and then with ValidationText = 'W rule failed' (3316 custom text). Records RecordsAffected, Errors, EditMode, stored row readback, and nativeRead keep:true bytes before and after every write.
